about_title: Positioners, rolls and manipulators for the welding shop
about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification by a maker that exports metalworking machinery to more than 70 countries, inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with a CSA-approved panel on every 3-phase machine, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.

Welding automation brings the seam to the welder: positioners tilt and turn the part so every weld is made flat, turning rolls rotate vessels, tanks and pipe under the torch, column and boom manipulators carry the welding head along the seam, and welding tables hold the parts square while downdraft tables draw off grinding dust and fumes.
